verdict.rationale: USCIS is a government immigration agency. Its offerings are online filing, case-status tools, and a small developer API platform (Case Status and FOIA APIs), none of which host user-defined automations. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a workflow-platform capability, so this story is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence suggests USCIS ships any such automation feature that would make the axis apply.
